title: Treasury Vault Door
purpose: Security and sovereignty surfaces; trust and custody messaging.
story: The great vault door of a treasury, half-swung on its hinge — the threshold of the sovereign reserve, brass and steel at rest.
environment: A vault antechamber, the massive circular door dominating a narrow stone passage lit from one side.
architecture: Heavy security interior — a thick reinforced portal set in a granite surround, a low vaulted ceiling beyond the door.
composition: The circular vault door off-centre and three-quarter, warm light raking the brass bolt-work, the passage falling into deep negative space.
continuityNotes: Holds the set's near-black grade with one warm source and brass-on-black palette established in scene-01.
